description: The Medium Resolution Imaging Spectrometer (MERIS) measured reflected sunlight in fifteen programmable visible and near-infrared bands. Its principal mission was ocean and coastal water colour measurement.
short_description: Envisat Medium Resolution Imaging Spectrometer (MERIS) 15 bands
facility_description: Envisat was an ESA Earth-observation satellite monitoring land, atmosphere, oceans and ice.
notes: MERIS Online Dissemination has a restrictive website copyright policy, but its scope relative to instrument response curves is not established. Exact NJM curve source and applicable data licence require confirmation; free data access alone does not establish redistribution rights.
